cases.case_label: Japanese founder-type Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 (c.4052_4053ins328)
cases.disease: Hereditary retinal degeneration (autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 328-bp Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 disrupts the reading frame and introduces a premature stop (p.Tyr1352Alafs*9); found in 16 unrelated Japanese HRD patients, 6 homozygous and 6 compound heterozygous with c.4196del or p.Arg1933*, and in 1/524 controls.
cases.quote: This insertion caused the disruption of the reading frame by introducing 328 additional nucleotides, including a premature termination codon in the canonical RP1 coding sequence.
